mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.info */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.PLACE_ADDRESS AS placeAddress , S.GENRE AS genre , S.HOST AS host , S.CONTACT AS contact , S.AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.IS_DELETED AS isDeleted , S.INFO AS info , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.INSERT_ID AS insertId , S.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate , S.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , (SELECT MIN(SG.PRICE) FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE SG.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS minPrice , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID AND IFNULL(SE.SEAT_STATUS, 'available') = 'available' ) AS remainCount , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate , (SELECT MAX(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS endDate FROM SHOWS S WHERE S.SHOW_ID = #{showId}

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.search */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.PLACE_ADDRESS AS placeAddress , S.GENRE AS genre , S.HOST AS host , S.CONTACT AS contact , S.AGE_LIMIT AS ageLimit , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.IS_DELETED AS isDeleted , S.INFO AS info , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , S.INSERT_ID AS insertId , S.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate , S.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , (SELECT MIN(SG.PRICE) FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE SG.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS minPrice , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID AND IFNULL(SE.SEAT_STATUS, 'available') = 'available' ) AS remainCount , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate , CASE WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 'show' ELSE 'place' END AS matchType FROM SHOWS S WHERE S.IS_DELETED IS NULL AND ( S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR S.PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 0 WHEN S.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, S.SHOW_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size}

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.openSoon */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.PLACE AS place , S.GENRE AS genre , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , (SELECT MIN(SG.PRICE) FROM SEAT_GRADE SG WHERE SG.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS minPrice , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate FROM SHOWS S WHERE S.IS_DELETED IS NULL AND S.OPEN_DATE > NOW() ORDER BY S.OPEN_DATE ASC

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.mine */ SELECT S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.TITLE AS title , S.GENRE AS genre , S.PLACE AS place , S.OPEN_DATE AS openDate , S.POSTER_LINK AS posterLink , S.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS dateCount , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS seatCount , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEAT SE WHERE SE.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID AND SE.SEAT_STATUS = 'booked' ) AS bookedCount , (SELECT MIN(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS startDate , (SELECT MAX(SD.SHOW_DATE) FROM SHOW_DATE SD WHERE SD.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID) AS endDate FROM SHOWS S WHERE S.IS_DELETED IS NULL AND S.INSERT_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY S.SHOW_ID DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.insert */ INSERT INTO SHOWS ( TITLE, GENRE, PLACE, PLACE_ADDRESS, HOST, CONTACT, AGE_LIMIT, POSTER_LINK, INFO, OPEN_DATE, INSERT_DATE, INSERT_ID ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{genre}, #{place}, #{placeAddress}, #{host}, #{contact}, #{ageLimit}, #{posterLink}, #{info}, #{openDate}, NOW(), #{loginId} )
mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.ShowsMapper.allPosterLinks */ SELECT POSTER_LINK FROM SHOWS WHERE POSTER_LINK IS NOT NULL AND IS_DELETED IS NULL
